title: Routing by real task cost: record tokens and cost per model and category, and let the derived table prefer the model that is actually cheaper per task

AC1.note: src/harness/routing/task-cost.ts: TaskCostRecord + statsForKey/allStats/statsFor, keyed by (providerId,modelId,category); 26 hermetic pure-function tests in task-cost.test.ts, no fs/network

AC2.note: readTaskCostStore/writeTaskCostStore/appendTaskCostRecord via ensureKeryxSubdir(['routing'])+writeOwnerOnlyFileAtomic (0600), MAX_SAMPLES_PER_KEY=200 rolling window; missing/malformed file degrades to {} (tested)

AC3.note: tui-shell.ts wraps io.onUsage per turn to sum THIS turn's tokens, calls recordTurnTaskCostBestEffort in the .finally() with success=!turnFailed; behavioral test in tui-shell.test.ts + wiring pin in task-cost-shell-wiring.test.ts

AC4.note: deriveDefaultTable gains optional taskCostLookup; preferByMeasuredCost applies only when n>=MIN_MEASURED_TASKS(20) on both sides and both medianCostUsd known, and only flips to the stronger candidate when the lighter one is NOT strictly cheaper

AC5.note: rule documented inline in derive-default-table.ts (preferByMeasuredCost doc comment); 6 dedicated tests: below-bar, at-bar-cheaper, at-bar-not-cheaper, equal-cost, unknown-cost, no-lookup

AC6.note: keryx routing stats [--json] added to src/commands/routing.ts; docs updated in cli-reference.md, help-groups.ts, commands-by-task.md (regenerated); 4 CLI tests in routing.test.ts

AC7.note: describeTaskCostSuffix + formatRoutingListLines threading in routing-inspector.ts; shown only for source==='derived' with known stats; 5 tests in routing-inspector.test.ts

AC8.note: bun run typecheck clean, bun run lint clean, task-cost.test.ts (26 pass), derive-default-table.test.ts (35 pass), tui-shell.test.ts (159 pass), routing.test.ts (32 pass), routing-inspector.test.ts + task-cost-shell-wiring.test.ts (20 pass), scripts/opentui-tests-no-skips.ts src/tui (1320 pass, 0 skipped)

AC9.note: live check recorded in flow journal 2026-09-25T20:01: real appendTaskCostRecord seed into the real per-user data dir, keryx routing stats + --json against it, verified 0600, then cleaned up
